title: Appendix audit of repeated wording: first actual observation
instructions: Inputs, expected output, actual output and differences are shown in order. The agent evaluates the returned claims against the saved source image. Comments are optional; this is not a permission request. Enter your name to comment, Save draft to keep unfinished feedback, or Submit review to send it.

evidence.label: 1 · Inputs: original text, image and older model proposal
evidence.text:
The compact audit receives nine source targets: appendix headings and the left-column passage. All original target text, the image and the complete older proposal are retained. The model is asked to report source-supported discrepancies and inspection coverage for every target; this is an audit, not a new corrected transcription. Expected answers below were saved separately before these calls and were not inserted into the model prompt.

4 · Differences: agent evaluation against the source
evidence.text:
Run 1 — First appendix reply correctly detects the omitted printed that in the saved proposal and proposes restoring that that. It also proposes the correct raw year1862. But it repeats P7and omits P9, includes unchanged readings as concerns, misassigns header errors to P7, and proposes changing the already-correct be it further enacted to he it further enacted, contradicting the scan. The remaining Presi- dent split is not reported. Host validation rejects no-ops; separate alias/quote/source checks expose additional defects. This is partial source recognition, not a valid complete audit.

Only the first of three planned observations exists. Later calls remain subject to feedback, known usage, positive shutdown and the original limits.

The detailed assessment records each source check and any extra finding. Software format checks, model self-reports, source-image AI assessment and human judgment remain separate. Agreement between repeated calls alone is not accuracy. Original sources, older proposals and human answers are unchanged.
